Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Coupa invite sent — please accept when you have a moment

Hi Rajiv,

I sent an invite from our Coupa tenant to onboarding@acmesupplies.com this morning for supplier setup (you should have received a link titled "Redwood Inference — Supplier Onboarding"). Can you confirm you saw it and are able to complete the SSO step?

Quick notes:
- The invite uses SAML SSO; if your IdP prompts for an attribute named "email" (some IdPs use "mail"), that can cause the redirect to fail.
- If you run into issues, reply here with a screenshot and we can escalate to Coupa support and create a one-off manual profile.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,
Sean Gallagher

Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 10:04:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Coupa invite sent — please accept when you have a moment

Hi Sean — thanks for the invite. I clicked the link but the SSO redirect fails with the error code shown in the screenshot (attached). Our IdP team says the SAML assertion is arriving without the "mail" attribute and Coupa is looking for "email". They asked if you can confirm what attribute name Redwood is sending in the SAML?

Screenshot attached: sso-error-screenshot.png

If we can't get the IdP mapping changed quickly, can you create a supplier record manually so we can progress POs? We have an urgent PO waiting.

Regards,
Rajiv Shah
Head of Procurement
Acme Supplies
rajiv@acmesupplies.com
+44 20 7946 0998

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Rajiv Shah <rajiv@acmesupplies.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Coupa Support <support@coupa.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 12:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coupa invite sent — please accept when you have a moment

Thanks for the screenshot, Rajiv — that helps. Monica, can you pick this up with Coupa support?

Coupa: quick summary — Acme's IdP is returning SAML attributes under "mail" but our SP config expects "email" which results in a failed attribute mapping during the SSO assertion. The affected user is onboarding@acmesupplies.com and the invite was sent from tenant redwood-prod.

Possible short-term options:
- Coupa support adjust SP mapping on tenant side to accept "mail" as an alias for "email" (preferred, if supported).
- Provide a one-off manual supplier profile for Acme so they can receive the PO while SSO is remediated.

Monica — if you need logs I attached the invite event export (coupa-invite-log.txt). Rajiv — if you're able to put your IdP team on a quick call with Coupa, that may speed things up.

Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Rajiv / team — update from Coupa support (on the call just now): the Coupa SP cannot be reconfigured for legacy attribute names on an existing invite, but they offered two remedies:

1) We can create a manual supplier profile for onboarding@acmesupplies.com so the open PO can be issued. This will be visible in the tenant and Acme can later claim the profile after IdP adjustments.
2) Acme's IdP team can add a runtime attribute alias mapping so the assertion includes "email" alongside "mail" — they confirmed this is a small IdP change and would take ~1 business day.

Coupa asked us to confirm which option we'd like. To avoid delaying the PO, we've created the manual supplier record internally. Rajiv, you should see the PO in Coupa under supplier "Acme Supplies (manual)"; please confirm receipt and we will mark the onboarding invite as pending until your IdP change is complete.

Next steps / asks:
- Rajiv: confirm PO visibility (I can re-send if you don't see it).
- Rajiv / IdP team: please add an alias for "email" or map "mail" -> "email" and let us know when done so we can retire the manual profile.
- Laura / Sean: I'll patch the Coupa invite notes and close the ticket when Acme claims the account.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Vendor Programs Specialist
Redwood Inference
